bio: Hello everyone, and welcome to Harvard! My name is Eva, and I am a Senior Preceptor in Mathematics. Originally from a small island in Greece called Syros, I have lived in Greece, the UK, and Canada, pursuing my studies in Physics and Mathematics. My PhD focused on the mathematics of black holes! Now, my journey has brought me here to share my passion by teaching introductory math. Outside of work, I love dancing, especially to swing music, exploring recipes, and traveling the world. I'm also into watching lots of movies and exploring new hobbies. Plus, I have a ginger cat named Spyros, who is also from Greece and tends to steal the spotlight! I am excited to meet you all and share my journey with you! Community Yards Ivy Yard Area Specialty Proctors Programming Staff Proctors Role Proctors Specialty Proctors
